about: The canonical model inventory: every model the system runs or keeps, with its use, inputs, outputs and known limitations. The IDs and names are the ones the validation pack uses (docs/model_validation/README.md §1); test_dashboard.py checks that every pack ID is here under the same name. Tier: production = feeds a published number every session; backtest = feeds the backtest; research = kept for comparison or as a negative result, feeds nothing. Materiality: how much a published number depends on the model (high: a headline number or its sign; medium: a secondary published number; low: diagnostics only). test_dashboard.py checks that every listed module and artifact path exists.

models.name: Heston / Bates pricing engine
models.use: Lewis (2001) contour integral with a Black–Scholes control variate on an adaptive trapezoid; prices every option the calibrator, the Greeks surface and the scorecard need.
models.inputs: Heston / Bates parameters, forward, strike, maturity
models.limitations: Quadrature target 1e-10 of DF·F; 5e-9 of F at the slowest-decaying corners of the parameter box.

models.name: Implied-vol solvers
models.use: Safeguarded Newton (implied_vol_black) and bisection (black76_implied_vol): chain cleaning, calibration targets, Greeks.
models.inputs: Option prices, forwards, discount factors
models.limitations: An in-the-money price whose time value is lost to rounding has no implied vol: the solver returns a missing value by design.

models.name: Option-chain hygiene
models.use: Two-sided quotes, the parity forward and discount per expiry, the quote-state gate and session dating, before every fit.
models.inputs: Raw SPX chain (Yahoo, Cboe)
models.limitations: The calibrator does not drop quotes in static arbitrage (M14 screens and reports them); Yahoo closing books carry no quote time.

models.name: Joint Heston calibrator
models.use: Daily fit to the SPX smile and the VIX index term structure (multi-start trust-region least squares, analytic Jacobian) and its quality gate; headline of the Calibration page and source of the Greeks surface.
models.inputs: SPX chain (two-sided OTM quotes, parity forwards), ^VIX9D/^VIX/^VIX3M/^VIX6M
models.limitations: One-factor diffusion: misses the short end; σ sits on its box ceiling in 2 of 5 fits, and κ moves with that cap along a κ–σ ridge (refitted with σ ≤ 10 and κ ≤ 60 on 2026-10-16: σ 6.9, κ 27, out-of-sample 2.96 → 1.19 vol pts); the boxed fits price VVIX far above the market; the VIX-options leg has weight 0.

models.name: VIX index and VX futures under Heston/Bates
models.use: The model VIX indices of the calibrator's VIX leg (exact CIR Laplace transform) and VX futures out of sample.
models.inputs: Heston parameters, VIX tenors, VX settlements
models.limitations: Heston misses real VX futures by {vx_futures_oos_rmse}.

models.name: Greeks surface
models.use: Black–Scholes Greeks at the model IV (vomma, vanna, vega, OTM delta) and QV convexity by maturity and strike; the unstable-node flag.
models.inputs: Headline Heston parameters, spot, parity carry
models.limitations: Black–Scholes Greeks at the model IV, carry per maturity (Treasury r(T), q(T) from the fit's parity forwards); the vomma shock is sized from the fitted σ, on its 2.0 cap in the headline fit.

models.name: β = ATM vol / VIX proxy
models.use: Prices and marks every backtest straddle at ATM vol = β × VIX with Black–Scholes; it decides the sign of S1.
models.inputs: VIX term structure, a constant β estimated from stored SPX chains
models.outputs_note: the β the run used, recorded as atm_to_vix_ratio; its marks are in the NAV of full_results.parquet
models.limitations: Mark-to-model: no traded prices in the window; β is held constant over 2018–2025, and the first later chain (2026-10-16) gives 0.70.

models.name: Backtest engine and signals
models.use: Signals S1, S1C, S2, S3, S4 as delta-hedged 30-day straddles, marked to model; the Research page's negative result.
models.inputs: SPX closes, VIX family, rule labels, PDV forecast, β
models.outputs_note: BacktestEngine.save: the daily NAV per sleeve, then the trades and metrics
models.limitations: All P&L is mark-to-model at β·VIX; no option prices inside the window.

models.name: PDV volatility forecaster
models.use: 21-day RMS-vol forecast refitted daily (purged walk-forward): the Overview's VIX − forecast spread and the S1/S1C input.
models.inputs: SPX log returns
models.limitations: EWMA approximation of a path-dependent-vol kernel; backward-looking, so it cannot anticipate jumps; 6th of 7 on QLIKE among the forecasts compared.

models.name: Rule regime labels
models.use: Deterministic same-day label (R0 / R1 / R2) from rv₂₀, VIX and an adaptive VVIX gate; the backtest trades it lagged one session.
models.inputs: SPX closes, VIX, VVIX
models.limitations: Thresholds are fixed rules, not estimated; VVIX gaps are carried one session; 5.9% of labels flip within measurement noise (C22).

models.name: XGBoost regime classifier
models.use: Next-session regime probabilities, shown on the Research page only (demoted in C17).
models.inputs: Market features (vvix excluded)
models.limitations: Loses to the no-skill persistence baseline; never trades.

models.name: NN surrogate pricer
models.use: Fast approximation of the Fourier pricer; on no production path.
models.inputs: Heston parameters, strike, maturity
models.limitations: Trained domain narrower than the calibrator's box; out-of-domain inputs are refused; no committed benchmark backs a speed-up.

models.name: Two-factor Quintic OU
models.use: Joint SPX/VIX research model compared with Heston on one session.
models.inputs: SPX chain, VIX options, VIX indices
models.limitations: Not converged (iteration limit; ε on its −0.99 bound); Monte Carlo SPX pricing.

models.name: Quote-grade surface
models.use: Static-arbitrage screen and l1 repair, eSSVI and calendar-ordered SVI, one scorecard for every model in half-spreads, the VIX replicated from the chain; written for each accepted fit; the Surface page and the Overview's first result.
models.inputs: The session's stored SPX chain and the session's own fit (rate reference, quote universe)
models.limitations: Fitted to alternate strikes, so its out-of-sample set is an interpolation test; Yahoo quotes carry no quote time; the butterfly and calendar certificates are on dense grids, not in closed form.

models.name: Rough Heston
models.use: Lifted rough Heston (20 factors), compared with Heston on the same anchors, VIX leg and quotes in each session's calibration diagnostics; feeds no production number.
models.inputs: As M4, plus H in [0.02, 1/2]
models.limitations: H is weakly identified (on its 0.02 floor on 2026-10-16; 1/2, i.e. Heston, on 2 of 5 sessions); the 20-factor lift approximates the Volterra kernel (at most 0.085 vol pts from QuantLib's Adams scheme at H = 0.02, 14 days to 1 year).

models.name: Spot × vol scenario grid of a reference straddle
models.use: Full-revaluation P&L of a delta-hedged 30-day ATM straddle under spot and parallel vol shocks, sticky-strike and sticky-moneyness; rebuilt from each new headline fit.
models.inputs: The headline fit's 30-day smile and per-maturity carry
models.limitations: Instantaneous shocks (no theta); parallel vol shifts; one reference book, not a position book.

models.name: Statistical inference of the backtest
models.use: Bootstrap intervals, PSR/DSR, SPA/StepM, CSCV PBO, exposure-matched timing nulls and the forecast comparison for every sleeve; the Research page and the Overview's third result.
models.inputs: The canonical backtest run, the β grid, the C22 bridge, docs/trials_ledger.yaml, Cboe strategy indices
models.limitations: Inference about the β·VIX proxy, not executable P&L; one window, on which the rules were revised; the closed forms assume IID returns.

models.name: Forward ledger
models.use: Each session's signals as listed SPX straddles at the captured bid/ask, hash-chained per session and marked on later captured books: the only executable-price evidence.
models.inputs: The captured option book, the signals of an accepted fit
models.outputs_pending: no entry committed yet: the first is written on the next session with a live captured book, whatever the fit does
models.limitations: No entry committed yet; marks are the captured book.

models.name: Treasury zero curve
models.use: Bills and par yields to a zero curve, look-ahead gated and refused when older than 7 days: the calibrator's rate reference, the chain cleaner, C7 and the Greeks carry.
models.inputs: U.S. Treasury bill and par yields, NY Fed SOFR
models.limitations: Daily; falls back to ^IRX and records it when stale.

models.name: Delta-hedged straddle simulator (C7)
models.use: Daily Greek P&L explain of a hedged 1-year ATM straddle in 2020 (the Risk page's P&L explain).
models.inputs: SPX closes, VIX term structure, the 1-year Treasury zero rate at entry
models.limitations: One path; financing at one rate for the year (the 1-year Treasury zero rate at entry); Black–Scholes Greeks at the VIX term structure.

vendor_inputs.data: ^GSPC, ^IRX, the SPX chain the bot fits, provisional VIX-family rows
vendor_inputs.note: Delayed, end of day; no quote time on closing books; personal-use terms.

vendor_inputs.data: The VIX index family (primary from C23), VX settlements, the SPX/VIX book capture, strategy indices
vendor_inputs.note: 15-minute delay; personal, non-commercial terms; each capture records its fetch time, quote time and SHA-256.
Daily; used only after publication (look-ahead gate).
